recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed unless a future work group decision changes how doNotPerform should be represented in Request-pattern short descriptions.
issue_request: FHIR-17187 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Request-pattern issue raised for STU3. It said occurrence[x] short text did not reflect doNotPerform even though the full definition did, and approved changing the short to "When service should (not) occur".
initial_application: Historical commit 633021569c4ee210837d89828831cac8764c69bd explicitly listed GF#17187 and changed source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml so Request.occurrence[x] short became "When service should (not) occur". The same commit also aligned nearby Request.subject wording to include prohibited requests, and it remains an ancestor of the current branch.
additional_context: The Request logical pattern is still active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml retains the requested occurrence[x] short and says the activity or service is desired to occur or not occur. Later Request-pattern edits did not remove that wording. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later FHIR-core decision that conflicts with the current source; the only Jira keyword hit was an unrelated AU eRequesting no-change issue.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The reconciliation published an empty audit commit on the combined branch documenting that the current source already satisfies FHIR-17187.
